page.overview:
What is Six Feet Down Under EP?

Six Feet Down Under EP is a limited edition commemorative live EP released in Australia and New Zealand only on September 20, 2010 through Universal Music. Second part was released on November 12, 2010 again through Universal Music.

Both parts has been sold by Trans-Tasman record stores, Metallica online store and iTunes only. First part contains eight songs from bootlegs recorded by fans, and live recordings never released by the band (being two of each year the band performed in Australia). Second part contains eight songs from the early part of the tour in Australia and New Zealand in 2010 as voted by members of the Metallica Fan Club living in those areas.

All songs on Part 1 (except Fight Fire...) are from the albums, the adequate tour was promoting.

This is Part 1 of 2-CD set released separately.
